message.content: According to the conversation between LiHua and WolfgangSchulz, LiHua expresses a strong enthusiasm for exploring new features and content in "Call of Duty: Warzone," particularly following the game's upcoming updates. LiHua states, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends! Let’s hop on together when the updates roll out!" This indicates that LiHua definitely plans to dive back into the game after the updates are released, excited to experience whatever new features or modes the updates might bring and to continue playing with WolfgangSchulz and other friends.
